references.text: Man cannot redeem his brother or give God a ransom for him.
Why do you spend money on what is not bread, and your wages on what does not satisfy?
For what does it profit a man if he gains the whole world but loses or forfeits himself?

But God said to him, 'You fool! This night they will demand your life from you. Then whose will those things be which you have provided?' So is he who lays up treasure for himself and is not rich toward God.
Do not be deceived: God cannot be mocked. For whatever a man sows, that he will also reap.
